input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: The only warranty TrueLink gives (§9, p0059-p0060) is a Year 2000 date-processing warranty. There is no warranty that the Hosting/Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Interface or related software, no compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranty (those run only from Client, p0051 and p0056), and no repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy. Section 12 (p0076) then disclaims all implied warranties of merchantability and fitness, leaving the Client with effectively no substantive quality protection. That fails even the fallback position (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies). The disclaimer is prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT," so it does not swallow an added express warranty and no carve-out edit is needed; the minimal fix is to insert the express warranty and remedy after p0060. Redline validated ok:true.

proposal.summary: Add TrueLink performance/conformance warranty with repair-replace-refund remedy
proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's only warranty here is the Y2K provision, so there is no express performance or conformance warranty standing behind the Interface or the hosting and support services. We have added our standard warranty (workmanlike performance, conformance to documentation for 12 months for software and 90 days for services, compliance with laws, no malicious code) with a repair, replace, re-perform or refund remedy; we can accept a 90-day software / 30-day services period as a fallback.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that (a) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (b) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will perform in all material respects in accordance with its then-current documentation and applicable specifications, and for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement; (c) TrueLink will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance hereunder; and (d) the Interface and all related software will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code. Client's remedy for breach of this Section is, at TrueLink's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software or services.
